purpose: How the dashboard's Run QA may start a signed-in session. Read by src/lambda_function.py at import and by tests/test_run_qa_switch.py. Shipped next to lambda_function.py by deploy/deploy.sh and cdk/stack.py.

enable.why: Kill switch. Run QA signs in with a test login that passes through the model. Until it takes the shared run lease and uses per-run passwords (token-monitoring feature-53), the owner can turn it off without a code change.

qualifier.why: Harness endpoint to invoke (plan WS3). Dormant: when unset, invoke_harness gets no qualifier, which is today's behaviour.
